result.reason: The operative language includes the preferred six-month transition period at then-current rates, a 30-day machine-readable data return, and certified deletion. However, it unnecessarily extends the return obligation to all Works and Confidential Information, including upon termination of any single Statement of Work. Requiring Works to be returned within 30 days may conflict with the existing final-payment condition and therefore alters unrelated commercial intent. “Company data” is also undefined or inconsistently capitalized, and requiring all Confidential Information to be machine-readable is overbroad. The unexplained reordering of existing provisions is unnecessary.
